title: Zenith Hub V1
features:
Zenith Hub RELEASE — V1 Jujutsu shenanigans 
BF Chain
Auto-fire with configurable dash distance, fire delay and easing style.
Camera locks onto the target during the dash automatically.
Black flash window detection with post-dash lock timing.
ESP & Visuals
Box, corner, outline, skeleton, head dot, tracer, name, distance, kill feed, HP text and HP bar.
Cooldown revealer overlay on nearby players.
Fullbright and custom background image support.
Target Lock
Camera and body lock modes with smoothness, side offset and prediction controls.
FOV circle, wall check, sticky target, auto retarget and target info HUD.
Closest or closest-to-mouse targeting with per-player selection.
Teleport
Pathfind to any named location on the map with tween or invisibility mode.
Path visualization, adjustable speed and a stop button.
Combat
Auto combo, auto block, infinite stamina and hitbox expander with size control.
Movement
Speed, jump power, fly and noclip with individual value sliders.
Side Dash Assist
Bezier arc dash behind the target on J press.
Curve strength, arch height, flight duration, detection range and camera lock options.
Servers
Browser with ping, player count and FPS data.
Sort, filter, join lowest ping, join smallest, join random and rejoin current.
Misc
Music player with three tracks, volume control and next-track button.
Custom theme, accent colour and background image.
Config save, load and delete with auto-save and auto-load on join.
Anti-AFK, toggle UI keybind and server ID copy.
